module_docstring: SNI-local DRAFT contract for P04 v2 (conditional event-response, results family). DRAFT ONLY: registered is false, the S0 protocol register is not edited, nothing is sealed, and no outcome exists. This module CONSUMES owner-supplied values from Data OS identity, Company Event/Earnings, FIF, Capital Structure, Stock Identity, Options, Research Vault, and qledger/Evaluation. It does not fork or re-implement those owners. Canonical issuer and security identifiers are caller-supplied opaque strings owned by Stock Identity / Data OS; unknown identity stays UNRESOLVED / null; this draft never constructs an identifier from a ticker, name, code, or CIK.
authority_flags_enforcement: REFUSE (raise) if a caller tries to set any of rank_authority, gate_authority, size_authority, signal_authority, escalation_authority, or trade_authority to true. Every flag stays false. Nothing in this draft feeds a ranker, gate, sizer, escalation, or trade path.

successor_of.v1_membership_sha256_construction: sha256 of '|'.join(per-(protocol,h,TUNE) membership_sha256 for h in (5,21,63))
successor_of.v1_tune_still_printed: v1 computed and printed TUNE outcomes after detection and labelled them NON-CONFIRMATORY. v2 does not do that: detection precedes any outcome load, and a retired split yields no outcome.

vintage_rule.summary: Every price/return input to a split is read from a vintage pinned at or before the split's decision timestamp (as_of_utc). A vintage step (any revision of a value already used by an earlier decision) within the split window with |step| above tolerance RETIRES the split automatically before any outcome is read. The detector runs BEFORE outcomes are loaded: detection clock precedes outcome clock.
vintage_rule.as_of_utc: the split's decision timestamp; bound at seal; every price/return input is the vintage of that instant or earlier
vintage_rule.tolerance_unit: dimensionless relative step of the adjustment factor q_t = close_t / close_price_t, inherited from s1_infoleak.vintage_series / detect: a step is recorded when |q_t / q_{t-1} - 1| > 1e-6
vintage_rule.step_definition: a vintage step is any revision of a value already used by an earlier decision; on a close/close_price pair it is the relative move of q above STEP_TOLERANCE
vintage_rule.detector: s1_infoleak.vintage_series then s1_infoleak.detect; window is the split window under test
vintage_rule.effect: a step inside the split window with |step| above tolerance RETIRES the split automatically, class information_leak, before any outcome is read
vintage_rule.clock_law: detection clock precedes outcome clock; the detector is run, and any retirement is recorded, before outcomes are loaded
vintage_rule.then_known: historical facts known only after as_of_utc are never used as if known on that date
vintage_rule.descriptive_not_causal: a residual or stress statistic computed after a clean vintage check is DESCRIPTIVE, never causal, never news-impact
vintage_rule.hk_series: VINTAGE_UNVERIFIABLE when no close/close_price pair exists; disclosed; not retired
vintage_rule.root_cause_fix: pinned adjustment vintage at as_of_utc, plus the composite split digest that includes vintage_manifest (SL §8 step 5)

split_identity.composite_split_digest: sha256 of canonical JSON of {protocol, version, split_name, member_episode_ids (sorted), as_of_utc, vintage_manifest (sorted path→sha256)}
split_identity.canonical_json: json.dumps(obj, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False).encode('utf-8') then sha256
split_identity.member_episode_ids: sorted list of caller-supplied opaque episode ids owned by Stock Identity / Data OS; never constructed here from a ticker, name, code, or CIK; unknown identity stays UNRESOLVED / null
split_identity.vintage_manifest: sorted mapping of input path to sha256 of the vintage blob pinned at as_of_utc
split_identity.immutability: membership is immutable once sealed (A23); any change mints a new digest and a new version, never rewrites a sealed digest
split_identity.unsealed: no v2 digest is minted in this draft; the seat binds as_of_utc, member_episode_ids, and vintage_manifest at seal
split_identity.replaces_v1_construction: v1 composite TUNE digest a3b15693e32d9d2f44e5e4a78f90bdfb3ac2afece84b5691be12e03685804ed6 used sha256 of '|'.join(per-(protocol,h,TUNE) membership_sha256 for h in (5,21,63)) and did not pin vintage; that construction is retired with v1 TUNE

label_semantics.min_episodes_note: carried from v1; the seat may confirm at registration

rule.DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY: date clusters >= 2 AND episodes < min_episodes; this is NOT an abstain

label_semantics.evaluation_order: ABSTAIN_NO_EPISODES, then ABSTAIN_INSUFFICIENT_CLUSTERS, then DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY, then TESTED; first match wins
label_semantics.v1_correction: the v1 wording 'CI NOT ESTIMABLE (cluster-N < 2)' is explicitly wrong for the DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY case (date clusters >= 2 and episodes < min_episodes) and is corrected here. DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY is a descriptive label, not an abstain. An unestimable family ABSTAINS with a named reason (ABSTAIN_NO_EPISODES or ABSTAIN_INSUFFICIENT_CLUSTERS); never a default 0.5 fill (A25).
label_semantics.ci_under_descriptive_only: cluster-N >= 2, so an interval may be printed as a descriptive statistic; it is not a confirmatory test and does not convert the family to TESTED

graded_legs.rule: only the Alibaba ADR leg SEC:US-XNYS-BABA is graded; Tencent and both HK legs are counted and abstained, never graded (copied from v1 PREREG_SPEC.json scope; identifiers are owner-supplied, not minted here)

requires: immutable budget row before any trial

labels.status: DRAFT — not registered; no outcome; HISTORICAL-DESCRIPTIVE contract only
labels.identity_view: then-known at as_of_utc; caller-supplied opaque ids; RETROSPECTIVE_JOIN is not a v2 identity view

REG.note: this draft does not edit the register; the seat adds the §6 row after review

families.budget_basis: FLOOR; SL §8 step 5 carries v1 literal_n (13) as the successor floor (v1 declared_budget was 6)

clock_rules.s_c: first session on clock c whose REGULAR OPEN is strictly after t_avail (pre-open -> same day; in-session, HK midday break or after close -> next session; DISCLOSURE_DATE -> first session strictly after the date)
clock_rules.window: entry_anchor = calendar day before s_US; resolve_horizon_window(entry_anchor, h, HORIZON_UNIT_TRADING, MARKET_US); assert fill_date == s_US else ABSTAIN_FILL_MISMATCH; None -> ABSTAIN_RESOLVER_NONE
clock_rules.leg_return: close(coverage_date)/close(fill_date) - 1 on the vintage-pinned adjusted total-return close; both endpoint bars present on exactly those sessions else ABSTAIN_MISSING_ENDPOINT
clock_rules.excess: BABA return - SPY return (descriptive co-movement over W_h, never causal)
clock_rules.decision_time: D(s) = last NYSE session before s_US; every decision-time quantity uses the vintage pinned at or before as_of_utc and bars <= D(s); the day-s move is excluded and disclosed
clock_rules.W_h: sessions s .. s+h inclusive (IL §1); the overlap window used by IL §3
clock_rules.detection_before_outcome: vintage-step detection runs to completion, and any retirement is recorded, before any outcome series is loaded

collapse_rules.order: IL §3 steps 0..N run IN FULL before anything is counted (A22)
collapse_rules.duplicate_reports: repeated reports of one occurrence -> one event, earliest admissible t_avail
collapse_rules.programme: one programme -> one event; execution returns are evidence rows
collapse_rules.cross_counter: BABA and 9988 rows of one occurrence -> ONE alibaba episode; leg outcomes are columns of one episode, never extra N (IL §6)
collapse_rules.overlap: overlapping windows within an issuer group at the same h handled per IL §3 step 4 (absorb / confounded flags), never silently merged, never double-counted
collapse_rules.clusters: same-day shocks across issuer groups share a cluster key (trade date of s) and are counted in cluster-N, never merged into one episode (IL §8)
collapse_rules.exclusion_order: excluded-and-listed rows are removed before episode formation; the exclusion is listed with its ids

splits.TUNE: EMPTY in v2. SL §8 step 5: a successor of a retired TUNE does not refill TUNE; v1 TUNE members stay retired and are never reused, re-ranked, or moved. v2 is declared UNTUNED (TRAIN-only for any choice that would have used TUNE).
splits.TEST: prospective claims only; registration_gate.met is false, so this draft has no TEST membership
splits.purge: TRAIN episode with coverage_date >= 2024-01-01, or TUNE episode with coverage_date >= 2026-10-01 -> PURGED (counted visibly, never moved). v2 TUNE is empty, so TUNE purge is n/a.
splits.episode_key: sha256('{issuer_key}|{opener_family}|{opener_t_avail_utc_iso8601}|{opener_evidence_pointer}') (SL §1); issuer_key is caller-supplied opaque, never derived here
splits.never_refill: v1 TUNE members are not members of any v2 split

baselines.ii: sign of the trailing-63-session excess at D(s), using the vintage pinned at or before as_of_utc; exact bars on D and D63 for both legs, else direction 0
baselines.iii: direction of the all-events pooled prior = sign of the mean excess of all counted TRAIN episodes at that h (PRIMARY set), computed from TRAIN only; TRAIN cluster-N < 2 -> NOT ESTIMABLE (abstain with that named reason, never a 0.5 fill, never +1 by default)
baselines.challenger: NOT ESTIMABLE while hierarchy legs above own-name stay unregistered; own-name honest-N printed beside
baselines.pooling_weight: NOT ESTIMABLE whenever baseline (iii) is not estimable or own-name cluster-N < 2; the token is printed, never a number by default
baselines.proper_score: NOT SUPPORTED (REG P04: hit and excess are not a proper score)
baselines.hit_rule: hit = sign(excess) == direction; excess == 0 exactly -> non-hit, listed as a tie; direction 0 -> ABSTAIN

statistics.h0: post-event hit rate = 0.50 per horizon (null of the binomial, never a fill for an unestimable family)
statistics.test: exact one-sided binomial (greater) via math.comb; run only under label TESTED
statistics.hit_rate_ci: wilson_ci (3 dp); under DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY this is a descriptive interval, not a confirmatory test
statistics.mean_excess_ci: mirror-trick block_bootstrap_ci: dates=concat(k,k), vals=concat(x,-x), mask=concat([True]*n,[False]*n), stat='mean', default draws/seed; block = one episode window W_h; cluster variable = cluster key (trade date of s)

minimum_evidence.derivation: one-sided alpha 0.05, power 0.80, hit rate 0.60 vs 0.50
minimum_evidence.below_minimum: DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY — below the 153-episode minimum; not an abstain when date clusters >= 2

abstention_ladder: ABSTAIN_INSUFFICIENT_CLUSTERS (episodes > 0 and date clusters < 2: no test; per-episode rows may be printed descriptively)
DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY (date clusters >= 2 and episodes < 153; NOT an abstain; v1 'CI NOT ESTIMABLE (cluster-N < 2)' is wrong for this case)
first match wins; never a 0.5 fill (A25)
kill_hold_rule: Kill/continue per REG P01: a failed criterion prints KILL or HOLD-AS-RESEARCH and is never rescued by changing target, cohort or horizon after seeing results.

info_leak_predicate.series: q_t = close_t / close_price_t for every close/close_price pair supplied to a split (v1 offending pair: BABA and SPY)
info_leak_predicate.rule: any vintage step with |step| > 1e-6 inside the split window, after reading the vintage pinned at or before as_of_utc
info_leak_predicate.effect: the split is RETIRED automatically before any outcome is read; no outcome of that split is loaded or printed as evidence

trial_ledger.note: no v2 trial row is written by this draft; the seat records the immutable budget row before any trial
trial_ledger.effective_n: TrialLedger.effective_n = max(base, declared, 1); labelled effective N (trials) — never a sample N (IL §1)

membership_table: unsealed; empty in this draft; the seat materialises membership at seal. v2 TUNE is EMPTY. v1 TUNE members are not copied.
